##: The only Windows asset is named win_x86, but its PE header is AMD64 and the binary reports version 3.2.0 when run; a single top-level url/hash therefore covers Windows.
The pinned hash matches both the local SHA-256 of the downloaded ZIP and the digest on the GitHub release asset. autoupdate.hash is omitted so Excavator reads the asset digest directly.
Settings and state are written to ~/.git-timemachine/, not into the app directory, so no persist entry is needed. The CLI shells out to git commit, hence the git dependency.
description: Record Git commits at arbitrary timestamps with jitter and daily limits
notes: Configuration and state live in "~/.git-timemachine/" and survive Scoop upgrades.
The retime command rewrites history in place; it creates a <branch>-gtm-backup branch before starting.
